future_date_leakage.description: Verify that no date after 2019-08-31 appears in input.json or 01_case_input.json, and no event occurring after the decision date is described.

expert_conclusion_leakage.description: Verify that input.json and 01_case_input.json contain no pre-stated expert diagnosis, no embedded recommended intervention, and no framing that encodes the correct answer in the question or evidence.
